## Google letter to AP Govt.

From: Alexander Smith <smithalexander@google.com>
Sent: Saturday, October 4, 2025 4:39:19 AM
To: Bhaskar Katamneni IAS <secy_itc@ap.gov.in>
Subject: Data Center Project - Land Allotment

Dear Mr. Bhaskar,

Thank you again for the detailed discussions this week, I particularly appreciate all of your efforts while you have
been travelling internationally.

In order to ensure clear coordination on all matters related to the land preparation and allotment, we would like to
authorise Mr. Sanjay Bhutani of Adani to serve as an authorised point of contact with the Andhra Pradesh
Government in preparation for the land allotment. As shared with you previously, to facilitate the land allotment
process, please see the attached details of the relevant Adani entities that we are authorising to be used for the
formal allotment process for each of the three site locations.

As outlined in our DPR and discussions, all incentives in the GO will be issued to the applicant, Raiden Infotech
India Pte Ltd. Once the GO is issued we will shortly thereafter provide Mr. Bhaskar in your capacity as IT Secretary
with formal written notification of our Notified Partners for the purposes of availing incentives under the GO to deliver
on the Project.

Please let me know if you have any questions or require further action from us.

Thank you.

Alex

## Google association with Adani Enterprises reported in October 2022

THE TIMES OF INDIA

## Google takes on lease 4.64 lakh square feet space
at Adani data centre in Noida



*ఈ చిత్రంలో ఒక భవనం యొక్క గాజు ముఖభాగంపై "Google" అనే పదం తెల్లని అక్షరాలతో వ్రాయబడి ఉంది.*

NEW DELHI: Adani Enterprises has given on lease 4.64 lakh
square feet of space at its data centre in Noida to Raiden Infotech,
an entity of Google, for Rs 11 crore monthly rent, according to
documents accessed by CRE Matrix.

The documents, accessed by the data analytics firm, showed that
D C Development Noida Ltd, which is part of Adani Enterprises
Ltd, has leased 4,64,460 square feet of space at Adani data centre
in Sector-62, Noida for a period of 10 years.

The rental is Rs 235 per square feet per month. The starting
annual rent is Rs 130.89 crore and there will be 1 per cent increase

in the rental every year. The lease agreement was signed last month, the documents showed.
Email queries sent to Adani Group's flagship firm Adani Enterprises and Google remained unanswered.
In February 2021, Adani Enterprises had formed an equal joint venture with leading global data centre operator
EdgeConneX to develop and operate data centres throughout India.

To start with, the JV had announced building a network of hyperscale data centres in India, starting with Chennai,
Navi Mumbai, Noida, Vizag and Hyderabad.

In July 2021, Noida Authority had allotted 34,275 square metres land at Sector 62 to Adani Enterprises for setting
up a data centre with an investment of around Rs 2,400 crore.

Adani Enterprises Ltd had in November last year divested its 100 per cent stake in DC Development Noida Pvt Ltd
to AdaniConnex Pvt Ltd, which is an equal joint venture between Adani Enterprises and EdgeConneX.

Reported on
11th
October,
2022

[^1]: PTI | Oct 11, 2022, 11.40 PM IST

## Post by Mr. Gautam Adani with respect to Google

Post



*ఈ చిత్రం ఒక వ్యక్తి యొక్క పిక్టోరియల్ చిత్రం. ఇది ఒక పాత ఫోటో లేదా పెయింటింగ్ లాగా కనిపిస్తుంది. ఈ చిత్రంలో ఉన్న వ్యక్తికి నల్లటి జుట్టు, మీసాలు ఉన్నాయి. అతను తెల్లటి చొక్కా మరియు ముదురు రంగు కోటు ధరించి ఉన్నాడు.*

Reply

Gautam Adani
@gautam_adani

A monumental day for India!

Adani is proud to partner with @Google to build India’s largest AI data
centre campus - in Visakhapatnam - engineered specifically for the
demands of artificial intelligence.

This facility will house the TPU and GPU-based compute power required
for deep learning, neural network training, and large-scale AI model
inference and create an ecosystem that accelerates AI-driven solutions
for India's most critical sectors - from healthcare and agriculture to
logistics and finance.

We are honoured to be building the engine to power India's AI revolution,
providing the tools for our nation's brightest minds to solve complex
challenges.



*ఈ చిత్రం ఒక అధికారిక సమావేశం లేదా సమావేశం నుండి తీసినట్లు కనిపిస్తుంది. ఎడమ వైపున, ఇద్దరు వ్యక్తులు కలిసి నిలబడి ఉన్నారు; ఒకరు బూడిద రంగు సూట్ మరియు ఎరుపు రంగు టై ధరించి ఉండగా, మరొకరు ముదురు నీలం రంగు సూట్ మరియు తెలుపు రంగు చొక్కా ధరించి ఉన్నారు. వారు ఒక పెద్ద, అలంకారిక ఫ్రేమ్ చేసిన కళాఖండం ముందు ఉన్నారు. కుడి వైపున, ముగ్గురు వ్యక్తులు కలిసి నిలబడి ఉన్నారు, వారందరూ ముదురు నీలం రంగు సూట్లు మరియు తెలుపు రంగు చొక్కాలు ధరించి ఉన్నారు. వారు కూడా అదే రకమైన కళాఖండం ముందు ఉన్నారు. ఈ అమరిక ఒక వృత్తిపరమైన వాతావరణాన్ని సూచిస్తుంది, బహుశా ఒక కార్పొరేట్ లేదా ప్రభుత్వ కార్యక్రమం కావచ్చు.*

## Letter from GOAP to Singapore Government dt. 09.03.2021

G. JAYA LAKSHMI, IAS
Principal Secretary to Government



*ఈ చిత్రంలో మధ్యలో భారత జాతీయ పతాకం (అశోక చక్రం) ఉన్న వృత్తాకార చిహ్నం ఉంది. చిహ్నం చుట్టూ "ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ ప్రభుత్వ" అని వ్రాసి ఉంది.*

To
Mr. Sopnendu Mohanty,
Chief Fintech Officer,
Monetary Authority of Singapore,
10 Shenton way, MAS Building,
Singapore 079117.
sopnendu_MOHANTY@mas.gov.sg
Contact number: +65-6229 8822

## Lr.No: ITC01-ITOPROM(ITPR)/9/2021-PROMOTIONS, Dated: 09.03.2021

Dear Sir,

Subject: Creation of Visakhapatnam-Singapore Data Corridor - Reg.

Greetings from the State of Andhra Pradesh!

Andhra Pradesh is located in the southern part of India and is the 7th largest State in
India in terms of the size of economy, with a Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of about USD
130 Billion in the year 2019-20. Also, Andhra Pradesh has a GDP per capita higher than the
national average at around USD 2,300. It is also the 10th most populous State in India and is
the 7th largest State in terms of area coverage at 160,205 sq. km.

The State has been a pioneer in the area of adopting advanced technologies in
Governance and has set a benchmark for other States to emulate in implementation of
citizen centric e-Governance platforms with the aim of improving the transparency and
efficiency of services to citizens. The Hon'ble Chief Minister has the vision of making the
State a fully digital Government in order to ensure good governance.

The State is consistently ranked No. 1 in Ease of Doing Business (EoDB) rankings of
the Government of India and World Bank in 2020 and provides an ideal business
environment for IT/ ITeS firms to establish its operations. The State has attracted several
domestic and international investments in the IT sector including HCL Technologies,
Conduent, WNS, and Patra along with banking operations of major banks such as HSBC and
Federal Bank. The existing IT workforce in the State is about 45,000 strong, and further a
large majority of IT workforce in India hails from the State of Andhra Pradesh.

The Government of Andhra Pradesh has recognized the potential of digital economy
which necessitates a strong growth of Data Center ecosystem with the capacity to fulfill the
growing demands of the country. In this context, the State Government has recently
approved the investment proposal of M/s Adani Enterprises Ltd. to establish an Integrated
Data Center and Technology Park in Visakhapatnam, which includes a 200 MW data center
park to cater to the data and cloud application demands of hyperscalers, an IT business park,
a skill university and a recreation center.

Visakhapatnam being the IT capital of AP, has an existing IT/ ITeS ecosystem as
highlighted above and offers a favorable geographic location on the East Coast of India

G. JAYA LAKSHMI, IAS
Principal Secretary to Government



*ఈ చిత్రంలో మధ్యలో భారత జాతీయ చిహ్నం (అశోక స్తంభం) ఉన్న వృత్తాకార ముద్ర ఉంది. ముద్ర దిగువన "అసెంబ్లీ ఆఫ్ లెజిస్లేటివ్ కౌన్సిల్స్ ఆఫ్ ఇండియా" అని వ్రాయబడి ఉంది.*

coupled with low cost of doing business, availability of skilled technology manpower, 24x7
power and water at competitive rates, thus making it ideal to become a Data Center hub for
South East Asia. M/s Adani Enterprises Ltd. has committed to the State Government to
attract and encourage global IT majors in its facility by leveraging the data center park.

Therefore, any initiative from the Government of Singapore and its entities which
explores the possibility of developing Visakhapatnam into a data corridor or a landing station
for channeling the flow of data from India to South East Asia and subsequently connecting it
to the global data hubs would be appreciated and encouraged. In view of the relative
proximity of Visakhapatnam to Singapore and the potential for growth, a data corridor
between Visakhapatnam and Singapore will help to enable a seamless experience for
applications requiring low latency in the emerging IT technologies.

We sincerely hope that the ongoing consultation between M/s Adani Enterprises Ltd
and Government of Singapore and its entities to develop Visakhapatnam as a Data Centre
would result in a positive outcome for a data corridor between Visakhapatnam and Singapore
and enable a mutually beneficial partnership which would benefit the people of the State of
Andhra Pradesh.

Yours Sincerely,



*X. పద్మనాభం
09|03|2021*

Principal Secretary to Government
ITE&C Department,
Govt. of AP.

Visakhapatnam being the IT capital of AP, has an existing IT/ ITeS ecosystem as

coupled with low cost of doing business, availability of skilled technology manpower, 24x7
power and water at competitive rates, thus making it ideal to become a Data Center hub for

Therefore, any initiative from the Government of Singapore and its entities which

for channeling the flow of data from India to South East Asia and subsequently connecting it

Category Employment

## Project implementation guiding principles ## a. Timelines i. The project proponent shall adhere to the following timelines and milestones from the date of handing over of the land, for implementing the proposed “Integrated Data Center Park and Technology/ Business Park” in order to claim incentives: ## Employment generation milestones for the “Integrated Data Center Park and Technology/ Business Park”: - Phase 1 - 3 years – Commencement of operations with at least 30 - percent of committed employment - Phase 2 - 4 years – 50 percent of committed employment - Phase 3 - 5 years – 70 percent of committed employment - Phase 4 - 6 years – 100 percent of committed employment (or) - Phase 5 - 7 years – 100 percent of committed employment If the project proponent fails to commence operations within 3 years and complete all phases of all the components of the project i.e. data center park, IT business park, skill university and recreation center, within 7 years, from date of handing over of the land, the Government shall resume the allotted land on pro-rata basis, as per the rules and regulations of APIIC in force at that time.
